chunks: And from him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'aba, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Similar to it, except that he said: 'Then the laudation, then the acknowledgement of the sin'.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order of components in a Shia supplication according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, establishes a precise liturgical structure for du'a, placing the confession of sins (i'tiraf) as a crucial bridge between praising God and presenting one's needs. In Shia scholarly tradition, this sequence highlights the spiritual psychology of supplication, where acknowledging one's unworthiness prepares the heart to receive divine grace, mirroring the prophetic practice of combining praise with humility.
